description:
HushThreads v0.0.15 has 19 patches for Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (com.instagram.barcelona).

Copy text works again on opened posts, and Open links in browser now sends ad links and lead form links to your browser too. Search's Follow suggestions row has its own switch. HushThreads settings have Quick setups and a Report a problem row, stay open when Threads redraws itself, and a new switch takes the settings shortcut out of the app icon's menu. Save photo works on smaller screens again, and saving got safer downloads and shorter messages.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 994 runtime tests passed locally. All 281 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 19 patches applied to Threads 451.0.0.51.80 without forcing, and the release receipt records the run.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (version code 512108444). The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### Changes

* **Threads:** Don't want HushThreads settings in the menu you get by holding Threads' icon? Turn off the new `Settings shortcut on the app icon` switch on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page and it leaves that menu right away, while Threads' own shortcuts stay. A long press on the Threads logo and the HushThreads row in Threads' settings still open the settings, and Pause leaves the switch as you set it.
* **Threads:** Pressing and holding the text of an opened post brings up Copy text again, the same as in your feed, so you get the whole post with its links. It had stopped doing anything on 451. A new `Copy text on long press` switch under Posts in HushThreads settings turns this on or off. It starts on and comes with every build.
* **Threads:** Open links in browser now also covers the places on 451 that used to skip it. An ad's link button and a swipe up on an ad in the media viewer send the ad's web link to your browser the same way post links go, and so do the privacy policy and disclaimer links on a lead form. Meta's own pages still open in Threads.
* **Threads:** Search's Follow suggestions row is gone too. It has its own switch, `Hide follow suggestions in Search`, right under Hide suggested users on the Feed page, and it starts on. Nothing takes the row's place, and search results and topics stay as they are. Turn the switch off, or pause HushThreads, and Search looks the way Threads draws it.
* **Threads:** Save photo and Save all work on phones with smaller screens again. On a 720 px wide screen Threads only keeps a photo at up to 750 px, and HushThreads took every one of those for a thumbnail and saved nothing. It now saves the largest copy there is, still prefers a full size one when Threads has it, and still never saves an avatar-sized copy.
* **Threads:** Disable video autoplay now also tells Threads' video prefetcher to hold off. The switch only held a feed video at its cover frame, so Threads could still start downloading a held video ahead of time. The patch now answers the prefetcher's autoplay-off question itself, only where the prefetcher asks it, so Instagram's older autoplay checker is left alone. With the switch off, paused or in safe mode, Threads' own answer goes back as before. Checked on a Galaxy S22 with Threads 451. The prefetcher got the hold answer with the switch on and Threads' own with it off, and a tapped video still played full screen.
* **Threads:** The HushThreads settings home page has two new rows. `Quick setups` changes a set of switches in one tap: Quiet hides ads and suggested accounts, Privacy stops most usage reports, takes tracking off shared links and hides your screenshots from Threads, and Back to defaults puts every feature switch back. A toast says how many changed. `Report a problem` opens a new GitHub bug report with your HushThreads and Threads versions, your phone and the switches you have on already filled in.
* **Threads:** More settings is now a heading on the HushThreads settings home page, with Appearance, Links, Updates, Set when you patched, Pause, backup and diagnostics and About listed under it. Every page is one tap from home and Back always goes home. Report a problem and Support HushThreads are still the last two rows, and the patch descriptions and bug report form point to the shorter paths.
* **Threads:** Don't use Quick setups? Press and hold its row on the settings home page and it's gone, and its help line says so. To bring it back, tap the Quick setups row on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page. Screen readers get the same press and hold on that row, and no other row offers one.
* **Threads:** HushThreads settings stay open when Threads redraws itself, after you change the font size or switch dark theme from the quick settings, or when Android closes Threads in the background and you come back. They used to close. They now come back on the page you were on. That holds with the settings open over two Threads screens and one of them closed, and on Android 9 in split screen when the Threads side sits for more than 30 seconds before you tap back into it.
* **Threads:** A settings file you pick for Import or Export isn't lost anymore when Threads redraws itself while the file picker is open, after a font size or dark theme change, or when Android closes Threads in the background to make room. The settings came back as if you hadn't picked anything. The file picker now opens through a small invisible screen of HushThreads' own, which keeps your pick until the settings are back. Access to the file ends once it's read or written. If Android closes Threads before that, it ends the next time Threads starts. Two quick taps on Import or Export open one picker, not two.
* **Threads:** After an export or import, the Export settings or Import settings row says how it went, in full, until you run another. That message used to show only in a pop-up, and newer Android versions cut those off after two lines, so a refusal like a damaged file lost its "Nothing was changed."
* **Threads:** Save's messages are short enough to read whole on Android 12 and later, which cut a message after two lines. On an S22 the proxy message stopped mid-word, and the slow-download one was just as long. A carousel's result now shows each line as its own message, so a line under the counts, like a proxy asking for a password, isn't lost. The German, Spanish, Indonesian, Portuguese and Turkish wording was shortened to fit too.
* **Threads:** A download that only trickles in now stops after ten minutes per file and says it was too slow, instead of holding one of the three save slots for as long as the server likes. A host lookup that never answers gives up after 20 seconds, and Cancel now ends a save that's still waiting on one.
* **Threads:** Cancel and the download time limit now end a save even when the phone's proxy service stops answering. Waiting proxy calls share the fixed limit on background network checks, so repeated attempts can't keep creating threads.
* **Threads:** A save's download now has a connection of its own that never asks Threads' cookie store or sign-in prompts for anything, so it can't send a cookie or a password, and it drops every cookie a server or a redirect sets. It still goes through the proxy your Wi-Fi or phone settings name and checks the server's certificate the same way. If that proxy asks for a password, the save stops and tells you, since it never sends one.
* **Threads:** On Android 9, a save without Threads' Storage permission now stops before it downloads anything and tells you where to turn the permission on. A carousel stops fetching its remaining pages if the permission is taken away partway through.
* **Threads:** Joining the picture and sound of a VP9 save (or AV1 before Android 14) now stops before it would take more than 24 MB of memory, and the save falls back to the single file. A file built from millions of tiny parts can't run Threads out of memory that way anymore. Cancel is also noticed while the join is still reading the tracks.
* **Threads:** When a save finds no picture or video it can keep, the diagnostics report now lists the kind and size of every address it looked at, so a bug report shows why. It never includes the addresses themselves.
* **Threads:** When the regular Instagram app from Meta sits beside your patched Threads, the Links page in HushThreads settings says Instagram won't open Threads posts or profiles here. That's Instagram's own check, and it's why Instagram says it couldn't load the website.
* **Threads:** When the settings list can't be put on the HushThreads screen at all, the screen shows Retry and Back instead of staying blank. Retry opens the page you were headed to, with your switches as you left them.
* **Threads:** When Threads rebuilds its screen with the settings open (after a text size change, say, or when Android closed Threads in the background), a settings page that fails to come back now gives way to a fresh page. Before, that failure would have crashed Threads, since it happens where the settings' own Retry and Back can't catch it.
* **Threads:** TalkBack now reads the Threads logo at the top of the feed as "Threads". Before, it stopped on the refresh spinner inside the logo and said "Progress bar". The README also says the logo ignores taps and holds while the feed loads or refreshes.
* **Threads:** TalkBack no longer stops on the HushThreads settings list as a whole to offer a long press that does nothing there. Quick setups, the one row with a long press, still offers it.
* **Threads:** HushThreads now keeps a note of how each switch starts in the build you patched. When a later build changes how a switch starts, one you never changed keeps the setting it had. Earlier builds left no such note, so this starts working with the update after this one.
* **Threads:** Settings file access stays tracked when a disk write or Android's permission service fails. Cleanup retries after a restart, and retrying the same file can't keep lasting access without a saved cleanup record.
* **Threads:** Morphe Manager lists every change of the release your Threads was patched with, not just a short summary. For that one release Manager shows the patch bundle's description instead of the changelog, and the description was a paragraph while every older release listed its changes. It now goes on with the release's Threads bullets after the summary. You'll see it from the next release on.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide suggested users
patches.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, and the Follow suggestions row in Search. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so does the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its two switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: HushThreads settings
patches.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Max image quality
patches.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Remove share targets
patches.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Save photos and videos
patches.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

release_notes:
HushThreads v0.0.4 has 10 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it works with Threads 448.0.0.54.85 too. Four of the patches are new, and the share links you hand out are cleaner.

## New patches

- **Open links in browser** opens a web link you tap in Threads in your own browser, or in the app Android picks for that site, instead of Threads' built-in browser. A link wrapped in Threads' click tracker goes out as its real address with `fbclid` and the other tracking tags taken off. Threads, Instagram, Facebook and Meta pages stay in Threads so sign-in and Accounts Center keep working. It's on by default and has its own switch under Privacy.
- **Disable video autoplay** keeps videos in your feed, on profiles and in threads on their cover frame as you scroll. Tap one and it plays full screen with Threads' usual controls. It's off by default, so pick it in Manager if you want it.
- **Block background-return feed refresh** keeps your place in For you when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts. It's off by default too.
- **Hide suggested users** takes the cards that suggest accounts to follow out of your feed. It has its own switch, and ordinary posts and reposts stay where they are.

## Changes

- **Sanitize sharing links** now hands out the post's own link, `threads.com/@name/post/code`, in place of Threads' short share link. Threads makes a new short link every time you share, each one tied to that share. Copy link gives you the clean link now.
- Threads 448.0.0.54.85 for arm64 is supported alongside 449.0.0.54.82. All 10 patches apply to both.
- Safe mode got a full check on a Galaxy S22. If Threads crashes three times in a row right after it starts, HushThreads pauses itself on the next start so you can get back in, with your switches kept. Resume brings every patch back.
- The Pause, Resume and Undo button next to HushThreads' status is bigger and easier to tap.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.32.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.4 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads **449.0.0.54.82** (version code 511908382) or **448.0.0.54.85** (version code 511808302).
3. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
4. Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

448 runtime tests and 156 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 10 patches applied without forcing to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed.
